description: This file defines classes related to DVB Time and Date Tables (TDT and TOT), including parsing logic for section data and handling of time information.

classes.name: TDT
classes.description: Represents the DVB Time and Date Table, capable of parsing section data to extract the current time.

classes.name: TOT
classes.description: Represents the DVB Time Offset Table, inheriting from TDT, with additional descriptor parsing.

methods.name: TDT()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the time object.

methods.name: TDT(const MPEG::Section& data)
methods.description: Constructs a TDT object by parsing section data to extract date and time.

methods.name: IsValid()
methods.description: Checks if the parsed time is valid.

methods.name: TOT(const MPEG::Section& data)
methods.description: Constructs a TOT object by parsing section data.

methods.name: Descriptors()
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the descriptors contained in the section data.
